scenes.display_title: Bed frames, support and mattress fit
scenes.spoken_text: Mattress, frame and support form one coordinated system. Distinguish fit geometry from load-carrying performance and identify the information needed before releasing a bed-base detail.
scenes.caption: Mattress, frame and support form one coordinated system. Distinguish fit geometry from load-carrying performance and identify the information needed before releasing a bed-base detail.

scenes.display_title: Match the mattress and frame opening
scenes.spoken_text: Record the mattress model, dimensions and support requirements, then show frame opening, external envelope and sleeping level. A commercial size name does not guarantee interchangeability. Check mattress placement/removal and bedding access with the selected products. Interface clearance comes from their requirements and the detail, not a universal extra dimension added to every bed.
scenes.caption: Defined mattress, frame opening and final sleeping level.

scenes.display_title: Trace the support and load path
scenes.spoken_text: Trace loads from mattress to foundation, frame and floor supports. Show how any centre support connects and bears, rather than drawing an unsupported line. Slats and a solid deck are not automatically equivalent: check mattress compatibility, ventilation and performance. Slat dimensions, spacing and support count require verified system information, not inference from a picture.
scenes.caption: Every support shown needs a defined connection and bearing path.

scenes.spoken_text: Define the frame/support/mattress assembly sequence and connector access. A lift-up storage base adds a mechanism with its own compatibility, restraint and movement requirements; it must not be attached to an unverified frame by guesswork. Inspect the assembled system using approved requirements and record results and use instructions rather than inventing a load test.
scenes.caption: A lifting mechanism is a separate system decision.

scenes.spoken_text: Option A replaces slats with a solid deck without checking mattress requirements. Option B documents compatible support, bearing and connections. Develop B, or obtain a technical review of A’s change before accepting it. A simpler appearance does not prove compatibility. Decision: verify mattress compatibility and performance before changing support type.
scenes.caption: Decision: verify mattress compatibility and performance before changing support type.
